definitions.explanation: A large number of people crowded together, often in a busy, noisy area. Emphasizes the chaotic nature of a crowd.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{雑踏|ざっとう}⟦していた→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The station was crowded with people.

examples.japanese: {雑踏|ざっとう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{友人|ゆうじん}→友人：03649_yuujin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見失|みうしな}った→見失う：14129_miushinau⟧。
examples.english: I lost sight of my friend in the crowd.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祭|まつ}り→祭り：03735_matsuri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{雑踏|ざっとう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{避|さ}けて→避ける：02109_sakeru⟧⟦{裏道|うらみち}→裏道：19428_uramichi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{歩|ある}いた→歩く：00538_aruku⟧。
examples.english: I walked the back streets to avoid the festival crowds.

notes:
{雑踏|ざっとう} emphasizes the chaotic, bustling nature of crowds.

USAGE:
- Often used for urban crowds, especially at stations, shopping areas, festivals
- Can be used as a verb with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: {雑踏|ざっとう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to be crowded)
- Has a slightly literary or formal feel

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {雑踏|ざっとう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧: in the crowd
- {雑踏|ざっとう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{避|さ}ける→避ける：02109_sakeru⟧: to avoid the crowd
- {雑踏|ざっとう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{紛|まぎ}れる→紛れる：07572_magireru⟧: to disappear into the crowd
- {雑踏|ざっとう}⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧: crowd crush/accident

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {人混|ひとご}み: crowd (more neutral)
- ⟦{群衆|ぐんしゅう}→群衆：14930_gunshuu⟧: crowd, masses (more literary)
- ⟦{混雑|こんざつ}→混雑：02809_konzatsu⟧: congestion, crowding
